jobs.title: Techincal Product Manager
jobs.jd_full:
About BJAK

The original mission of BJAK is we believe people deserve smarter ways to plan, save and grow their money. This is the origin of our name.

Started in 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, its the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.

Today, we are expanding ways to help people in the region — this includes spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more. Our mission is help people get more from their money every day.

We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities from our offices and remotely, who truly enjoys their work. We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few.

If you're this person, we'd love to talk to you.

The Role

BJAK is building a Neobank Superapp for Southeast Asia. As a Technical Product Manager, you’ll own a product vertical end to end—such as payments and expense management, remittance, insurance, or wealth and trading—from strategy, outcomes, and roadmap through to the technical design and delivery of the systems behind it.

This is a product where real money moves, mistakes are immediately visible, and licensing, compliance, and third-party rails are core product constraints—not considerations around the edges.

We are AI-native by default, but AI is a means, not the goal. The bar is knowing where a model can genuinely improve an outcome, where deterministic systems must remain in control, and how to build products that are reliable, auditable, and trusted when money is involved.

What you'll be doing

  • Own a vertical end-to-end — outcomes and metrics, a backlog prioritised by value / risk / dependency / strategic priority, acceptance criteria crisp enough to build and test against.

  • Shape the technical design with engineering — system boundaries, money-movement correctness (idempotency, ledgering, reconciliation), third-party-rail reliance and rail-down behaviour, failure/retry/refund paths, security, latency, scalability, recovery.

  • Make hard trade-offs across correctness, speed, cost, reliability and UX — and defend them to an engineering, compliance or ops lead who pushes back.

  • Treat regulated constraints as first-class product inputs — licensing scope, CDD/KYC and limits, sanctions/PEP screening, transaction monitoring, data residency and privacy. Know which are hard launch gates and which are forward-readiness.

  • Apply AI where it earns its place — define what it's allowed to decide, where a human stays in the loop, how it's evaluated, and what it does when unsure. Every AI-surfaced number traces back to a real record.

  • Ship against external gates — build feature-complete behind flags; go live per rail as each partner and regulatory gate clears.

  • Work across Engineering, Design, Compliance, Operations, Treasury and Finance/Reconciliation.

What you'll need

  • Product leadership — significant experience owning a complex technical product end-to-end; strong judgement and decisiveness under ambiguity; ability to balance ambition against technical, regulatory and operational reality; can hold their own with senior engineers.

  • Technical foundation — solid system design (boundaries, datastores, queues/workflows, APIs, failure modes, consistency under concurrency); comfort reading, reviewing and challenging design docs; can sketch an architecture and a sequence. No production code, but technical enough that engineers don't have to simplify.

  • Domain— experience in a regulated / high-consequence domain (payments, banking, remittance, insurance, …) or demonstrable fast-ramp ability; understands why money movement is different (correctness over convenience, irreversible states, partners you don't control).

  • AI judgement — hands-on with LLM-based products; can frame a feature as eval-able (offline, online, human feedback); realistic on hallucination/drift/data gaps, including data-blocked vs model-blocked and when a model must not be in the loop at all.

  • Nice to have — engineer or highly-technical-PM background · zero-to-one · shipped AI-heavy consumer products · defined eval metrics for ML/LLM systems · AI UX + failure-handling intuition · SEA market experience.

Outcomes

  • Clear vertical strategy and legible roadmap

  • Ships fast and clears the gates that actually block launch

  • Money is correct and users are never misled about the state of their funds

  • AI features are valuable, predictable and trusted

  • Trade-offs made deliberately under uncertainty and hold up when challenged

  • Engineering, design, compliance, and operations are aligned with minimal friction


Location

This role is remote, but candidates must be based in Japan. We are hiring specifically for this market, so applicants should already be based in Japan.

Language

English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.

Interview Process

Our process is designed to move fast:

1. Online assessment or practical task

2. Role-specific interview

3. CEO / final round

For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1 week from the start of the interview process. Candidates who complete assessments quickly will be prioritized.

jobs.jd_full:
Description

Who We Are

Great Minds is a high-growth, mission-driven organization founded by educators in 2007. As a for-profit, Public Benefit Corporation, we believe all students deserve access to meaningful, challenging content—and all teachers deserve tools that are intuitive, effective, and built for the realities of today’s classrooms.

We develop high-quality, knowledge-rich math, science and ELA curricula grounded in research and designed in collaboration with educators. Our materials reflect real classroom needs and are built to drive lasting student outcomes.

We are committed to usability, coherence, and practical implementation—supporting teachers not just through curriculum, but with professional learning, purposeful technology, and responsive service that enable strong adoption and impact.

What We Build

Our products— Eureka Math and Eureka Math², Wit & Wisdom, PhD Science, Geodes, and the newly launched Arts & Letters ELA—are trusted by thousands of schools and districts nationwide.

  • Eureka Math is the most widely used math curriculum in the U.S., and is focused on balancing conceptual understanding, procedural fluency, and application.

  • Wit & Wisdom® and Arts & Letters ELA™ anchor our reading strategy with content-rich, grade-level instruction that integrates literature, history, and the arts, grounded in the science of reading. Geodes® complements our reading suite with decodable texts that pair phonics with meaningful content to support early literacy.

  • PhD Science is a hands-on K-5 Science program that sparks curiosity as students build enduring knowledge of how the scientific world works.

These programs reflect a shared belief in high expectations, joyful rigor, and deep respect for educators and students.

Where We’re Headed

Great Minds is entering a new stage of growth and product maturity. We are focused on building more connected, customer-informed experiences across the full educator journey—from curriculum to professional learning to platform and support.

Our long-term vision is to become a true partner in impact—not just delivering curriculum, but supporting educators in achieving outcomes at scale.

Job Purpose

Great Minds was built on a restless conviction: that every student deserves nothing less than our best, and that the status quo in curriculum has never been good enough. We’re looking for a Product Manager to help develop and execute the full lifecycle of our core Math product line to ensure it aligns to Great Minds’ mission of serving all students with high-quality, knowledge building, instructional materials. Reporting to the Senior Manager, Product, you’ll serve as the voice of the customer by bringing market research, user insights, and data-driven analysis to shape roadmap, scope, pricing, and go-to-market strategy. This is a role for a product leader who believes that coherence isn’t a feature, it’s a philosophy. The ideal candidate brings deep experience building and leading high-performing teams in K-12 math education, a track record of driving complex product portfolios from strategy through delivery, and an unwavering belief that every child is capable of greatness. This leader thrives in a mission-driven environment where urgency, rigor, and accountability are the standard.

Responsibilities

  • Partner with the content and research teams to reflect the instructional research and the math instructional model in the product design and development process.

  • Execute end-to-end product lifecycle activities including: market research, competitive analysis, product strategy and design, scope and roadmap development, pricing, and launch.

  • Collaborate with the Content team to develop and execute product strategy related to state adoptions, pricing bundles, sampling, and open territory/large-district opportunities for a product.

  • Conduct user interviews and coordinate user and classroom testing to validate product decisions.

  • Synthesize customer feedback, product analytics, and competitive market data into clear prioritization recommendations.

  • Monitor the P&L for your product line and surface risks and remedies to leadership

  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams, including Content, Marketing, Sales, Finance, Design, and Operations to keep vision and execution aligned.

  • Conceptualize and quantify product vision, including research, market mapping, competitive analysis, market opportunity, and strategic development.

  • Provide oversight and ensure alignment between the instructional philosophy, content development and Great Minds’ digital platform in the delivery of features and customer experience.

  • Proactively identify and resolve strategic issues within your projects that may impair the organization’s ability to meet its strategic, financial, and technical goals.

  • Own post-launch performance of your products, including adoption, usage, performance, retention, and renewal metrics.

Requirements

Requirements

  • At least 3 years of experience working in education publishing with a track record of success in product development, digital product management, curriculum development and/or project management, preferably in the K-12 education market

  • Deep respect for and alignment to the philosophy, instructional design, and pedagogy of Great Minds’ knowledge-building vision

  • Excellent stakeholder management skills, including customers, sales team, content development teams, product marketing, and senior leadership that require a sophisticated level of sensitivity and excellent judgment

  • Strong analytical thinking and decision-making skills to anticipate challenges, issues, or opportunities

  • Strong business acumen, with the ability to think about ROI, strategic pricing, and the potential value of ideas to help the team prioritize where and how to spend limited resources

  • Deep belief that every child is capable of greatness

jobs.title: Sr. Project Manager
jobs.jd_full:
Job Summary

The Sr. Project Manager will guide technical and non-technical delivery teams through its shift from Waterfall project management to a Product Delivery model, operating across both approaches while teams mature at different paces. This role is responsible for executing delivery work while also serving as a change agent, helping stakeholders and teams adapt to outcome-driven, roadmap-based value stream execution. Key outcomes include successful delivery of Life & Annuity product initiatives, index additions, and 3rd party/SaaS platform work, achieved in close partnership with Retail and Operations.

Duties & Responsibilities

  • Lead end-to-end project and product delivery, ensuring objectives are achieved across all delivery phases.
  • Establish scope, objectives, resource needs, budgets, timelines, and milestones, while managing changes through appropriate continuous planning and governance techniques.
  • Develop, maintain, and report on project plans, progress, and key metrics using both waterfall and agile frameworks.
  • Partner with stakeholders to define product roadmaps, requirements, build status reports and communication plans, and facilitate effective team and client meetings.
  • Lead risk identification and mitigation planning, track project dependencies and constraints, and escalate issues or concerns to Retail leadership as needed.
  • Run PI planning and execution cycles and program-level ceremonies, and coach teams and leaders on scaled agile principles.
  • Track and communicate program-level metrics while managing risks and impediments across the value stream.
  • Build and sustain relationships with third-party vendors and external partners and create/maintain comprehensive project documentation meeting Retail Implementation standards.

Supervisory Responsibilities: This role does not have formal leadership responsibilities but may provide guidance, mentorship, or subject matter expertise to others.

Knowledge, Skills & Abilities

  • Demonstrated knowledge of project, product, and business management principles, waterfall and value steam delivery methods and techniques and identifying critical paths.
  • Strong interpersonal skills including Teamwork, Responsibility, Dependability, Flexibility, Leadership, and Motivation.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills including facilitation and presentation tailored to the specific audience.
  • Ability to interact successfully with personnel at all levels of the organization in both technical and business areas with minimal guidance.
  • Ability to perform at a high level in a fast-paced environment while managing multiple projects and responsibilities.
  • Effectively coach delivery teams, Value Stream Leaders, and Product Owners on Agile mindsets, mechanics, and backlog/discovery practices.
  • Excellent leadership, negotiation, and problem-solving skills.
  • Team player with demonstrated ability to proactively identify issues and to influence key project and program decisions to achieve desired outcomes with minimal guidance.
  • Self-starter who demonstrates strong initiative and is able to operate efficiently in unpredictable and challenging project environments with minimal guidance.
  • Proficient in Agile Tooling (JIRA) and Microsoft Office Applications (Word, PowerPoint, Excel).
  • Must be able to work independently and be able to operate efficiently in unpredictable and challenging project environments.

Minimum Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in business administration, Project Management, Operations Management or related field. In 7+ years of relevant experience in Project Manager or Agile Leader in Life Insurance and/or Annuity industry.
  • Experience managing multiple simultaneous projects involving cross functional project teams within budgetary and schedule constraints.
  • Strong Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC) experience.
  • Combination of education and experience considered in lieu of degree.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with Waterfall, Agile and Iterative methodologies—certifications preferred.
  • Experience with JIRA, and/or other project management software preferred.
  • Program Management experience preferred.
  • PMP, Scrum, or Scaled Agile Framework Certification preferred.

Other Requirements

  • This position primarily involves sedentary work, requiring long periods of sitting, regular use of a computer, and occasional standing or walking, with reasonable accommodation available.
  • Perform other functions, duties and projects as assigned
  • Regular and punctual attendance

Ability to travel up to: 5% of the time

Role Overview

We are looking for a Technical Delivery Manager to join our Elastic Platform Operations (EPO)/Managed Services team. In this role, you will lead and scale the design, implementation, and ongoing operations of modern data platforms for multiple enterprise customers, ensuring reliable delivery and continuous improvement of their cloud data environments. You will collaborate closely with client sponsors, technical stakeholders, and globally distributed delivery teams to drive high-quality outcomes on time and within budget. You will also play a key role in major incident response, process improvement, and the development of delivery best practices across our Managed Services portfolio.

Key Responsibilities

Client Delivery

  • Own and drive the delivery and operational excellence of modern data platforms (including streaming, data lakes, and analytics) for multiple customer accounts.
  • Translate business and technical requirements into actionable Epics, Stories, and Tasks that mature and improve customer data platforms while aligning to phData methodologies and best practices.
  • Ensure engagements are delivered on time, within scope, and on budget, with clear measures of success and value for customers.
  • Lead and motivate client technical teams, providing hands-on technical leadership for design, implementation, and ongoing operational support of cloud data platforms.
  • Provide leadership during major incidents, ensuring effective coordination, communication, escalation, and follow-through to resolution, root cause analysis, and remediation.

Collaboration & Leadership

  • Collaborate with cross-functional partners including architects, engineers, and site reliability/operations teams in the US and India to deliver successful client engagements and seamless handoffs across time zones.
  • Develop strong relationships with sponsors and stakeholders, keeping them informed of progress and outcomes, hosting leadership discussions, and identifying opportunities to expand the value of our services.
  • Ensure teams are trained and prepared to deliver by driving accurate process documentation, clear internal and external communication, and continuous readiness for production operations.
  • Maintain proper staffing levels across accounts, balancing delivery between US and India team members to support continuous delivery and high customer satisfaction.

Practice & Firm Contribution

  • Deliver feedback and drive improvements to our overall Managed Services offerings through process optimization, knowledge sharing, and creation of accelerators and reusable assets.
  • Champion phData’s core values and foster a culture of accountability, ownership, and continuous improvement within delivery teams.
  • Contribute to the evolution of best practices for incident management, change management, and modern data platform operations across multiple customers.

Additional Responsibilities

  • Act as a trusted advisor to senior client stakeholders (Director and VP level), shaping roadmaps for cloud data platforms and influencing strategic decisions around data and analytics operations.
  • Mentor and coach architects, engineers, and operations team members, helping them grow technical depth and delivery capabilities across large and complex environments.
  • Help define and refine Managed Services standards, playbooks, and frameworks to support scalable growth across a broad customer base.

About You

You are a client-focused technical delivery leader who enjoys owning complex data platform operations, guiding teams through ambiguity, and building strong relationships with stakeholders. You are equally comfortable discussing architectural trade-offs with engineers and outcomes with business leaders, and you thrive in a remote, global, outcomes-driven environment.

Required Qualifications

Experience

  • 5+ years of experience in technical management, IT architecture, customer relationship management, project management, and/or delivery management, ideally within data, analytics, or infrastructure operations.

Technical / Functional Skills

  • Hands-on experience with at least one major cloud platform, specifically Amazon Web Services (AWS) or Microsoft Azure.
  • Technical knowledge deploying and managing modern cloud data technologies such as Snowflake, dbt, Fivetran, Airflow, Redshift, Matillion, Databricks, Azure Synapse, Qlik, StreamSets, NiFi, Cloudera, Coalesce, and EMR (not all required but familiarity with several is expected).
  • Background in IT operations, infrastructure, or production support, including managing modern data platforms or data warehouses for multiple customers of various sizes.
  • Experience leading technical operations teams through multiple large or complex projects, including backlog creation (Epics, Stories, Tasks), prioritization, and delegation.
  • Experience scoping and planning large-scale, complex technology infrastructure or modern data platform initiatives.
  • Demonstrated ownership of incident and escalation processes, including coordination among technical teams, end-users, and stakeholders through resolution, root cause analysis, and remediation.
  • Active daily use of AI coding tools (Cursor, GitHub Copilot, Claude, ChatGPT, or equivalent) with demonstrated judgment about when to trust, verify, and correct AI-generated output.
  • Ability to describe specific engineering tasks completed with AI assistance.

Consulting / Delivery Skills

  • Experience delivering services for external or internal customers in a professional services, managed services, or similar client-facing environment, including direct interaction with global customers and business partners.
  • Ability to interact confidently with Director and VP level stakeholders, guiding discussions, building relationships, and communicating complex technical information in accessible ways (written, verbal, and formal presentations).
  • Proven experience coordinating across technical teams managing IT infrastructure services or modern data platforms for multiple customers concurrently.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills in English.

Collaboration & Ownership

  • Demonstrated ability to lead and collaborate with distributed, cross-functional teams across regions (e.g., US, LATAM, and/or India) and time zones.
  • Strong leadership skills with a professional track record of creating, challenging, and improving processes and procedures.
  • Highly organized, strategic thinker, and effective problem-solver who can manage multiple priorities and accounts simultaneously with minimal supervision.
  • Flexibility to work across time zones as needed to support global teams and customers.

Education

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or a related field, or equivalent practical experience (degree preferred but not required).

Preferred Qualifications

Preferred qualifications help candidates stand out but are not required for success in this role.

  • Experience managing IT or data operations/production support environments, including leading data warehouse, ML, or data engineering teams.
  • Experience working with cloud data platforms such as Snowflake, Databricks, and Azure Synapse in a multi-customer or managed services context.
  • Additional experience with tools such as Qlik, StreamSets, NiFi, Cloudera, or Coalesce.
  • Prior experience in a consulting, managed services, or MSP-style environment supporting multiple enterprise customers.

Location & Time Zone Expectations

This role is based in the US and operates primarily in Central or Eastern US time zones, with regular collaboration with teams in India and across the Americas.

Why phData?

Benefits at phData

jobs.title: Sr. Digital Product Manager
jobs.jd_full:
How You’ll Make An Impact

At Strive Health, patients come first. We’re on a mission to transform chronic conditions by identifying risk earlier, coordinating thoughtful care, and supporting people through every stage of their health journey.

Our work reduces emergency visits, improves outcomes, and helps patients live fuller lives. You’ll work alongside passionate Strivers who care deeply about making an impact, show up for one another as One Team, and find ways to elevate the everyday.

If you’re looking for meaningful work where your contributions truly matter, you’ll feel right at home at Strive!

Benefits & Perks

  • Hybrid-Remote Flexibility–Work from home while fulfilling in-person needs at the office, clinic, or patient home visits.
  • Comprehensive Benefits– Medical, dental, and vision insurance, employee assistance programs, employer-paid and voluntary life and disability insurance, plus health and flexible spending accounts.
  • Financial & Retirement Support– Competitive compensation with a performance-based bonus program, 401k with employer match, and financial wellness resources.
  • Time Off & Leave– Paid holidays, vacation time, sick time, and paid birthgiving, bonding, sabbatical, and living donor leaves.
  • Wellness & Growth– Family forming services through Maven Maternity at no cost and physical wellness perks, mental health support, and an annual professional development stipend.

To learn more about our offerings, click here.

What You’ll Do

The Senior Digital Product Manager will be a critical part of the Digital Product team, partnering with an interdisciplinary team of engineers, clinicians, and operators to deliver on Strive’s Digital Product Vision and move strategic KPIs in a scalable and standardized way through tech-enabled solutions. This role will serve as the Voice of the Customer and SME in your product area, identify the most pressing problems to solve, and work with the cross-functional team to deliver user-driven solutions to optimize clinical workflows, reduce administrative burden, enhance the member/patient experience, and enable responsible AI-driven automation across patient and provider interactions. As a Senior Digital Product Manager in either the Patient Engagement or Patient Interventions digital product portfolio, this individual will be expected to thrive in ambiguity and creating clarity out of complex problems. This role will report to the Director of Digital Product. Following Strive’s Series D funding round, and with our Board of Director’s and Chief Technology Officer’s enthusiastic support and funding mandate, this role will directly contribute to developing and executing digital capabilities that leverage AI, automation, and analytics to drive measurable outcomes as we transform the patient and provider journey.

The Day to Day

  • Meet in person with internal and/or external stakeholders to facilitate team and business priorities/opportunities. Business travel may be required for opportunities to connect with stakeholders, serve patients, and attend Strive-sponsored team events.
  • Owns day-to-day functions of a digital product value stream, including executing on the product vision and roadmap.
  • Partners with Product leadership and stakeholders to define the product vision and KPIs, and product outcomes.
  • Executes day-to-day of product discovery, serves as the voice of the customer, facilitates interdisciplinary team to deliver on goals, and measures success or failure, with oversight from Product leadership.
  • Collaborates closely with Engineering, Data Science, Analytics counterparts within Strive’s Agile SDLC to translate strategic goals into scalable, high-impact product solutions.
  • Understands market and overall competitive dynamics of their product area with a focus on digital health, AI-enabled workflows, and value-based care models.
  • Demonstrates strong stakeholder engagement skills and can influence stakeholder groups while gaining trust across the organization.
  • Leverages data driven insights to make effective prioritization decisions and measure the success of initiatives.
  • Leads a cross-functional agile team, consistently driving focus and strong outcomes.
  • Demonstrates comfort in change and can facilitate a team to strategically adapt and evolve.
  • Contributes to continuous improvement of Digital Product team best practices, helping mature product operations, backlog hygiene, and sprint delivery discipline.

Minimum Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in a relevant field.
  • 5+ years experience in a product management role.
  • 4+ years experience at either a healthcare delivery organization or working on a technology product in an agile environment.
  • Internet Connectivity - Min Speeds: 3.8Mbps/3.0Mbps (up/down): Latency <60 ms.
  • Efficient and reliable transportation, including an active driver’s license, allowing for travel across an assigned region to meet business needs.
  • Ability to travel and be on-site to meet business needs.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Proven understanding of digital health ecosystems, clinical workflow technology, and healthcare data interoperability.
  • Proven track record in healthcare technology, ideally with value-based care, population health, or digital health platforms.
  • Experience leading digital patient experience initiatives (mobile/web/omnichannel).
  • Talent for distilling abstract ideas and product vision into actionable nuts and bolts user stories and acceptance criteria.
  • Demonstrated success in deploying AI/LLM solutions responsibly.
  • Experience operating within pod-based SDLC model, partnering directly with Engineering and Data Science teams.
  • Ability to collaborate effectively with Product Strategy, Clinical Operations, and Go-To-Market partners to ensure Digital Product roadmap aligns with enterprise priorities while remaining execution-focused.

Annual Base Salary Range: $108,500 - $136,000. This position is also eligible for a target annual bonus of 15%

Final compensation will be determined based on location, experience, and qualifications.

Strive Health is an equal opportunity employer and drug free workplace. At this time Strive Health is unable to provide work visa sponsorship. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, disability status, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. Please apply even if you feel you do not meet all qualifications. If you require reasonable accommodation in completing this application, interviewing, completing any pre-employment testing, or otherwise participating in the employee selection process, please direct your inquiries to talentacquisition@strivehealth.com.

We do not accept unsolicited resumes from outside recruiters/placement agencies. Strive Health will not pay fees associated with resumes presented through unsolicited means.

Our Mission

NewRocket, a global, full-service Elite ServiceNow partner, helps top enterprise leaders solve their toughest business problems and navigate change with confidence. Come join our Crew!

Our Approach to Work

Here, it’s not just about a job; it’s about fostering a healthy work-life balance, creating a culture that thrives on collaboration and innovation, and supporting professional growth for individuals and teams.

We believe in creating meaningful experiences, not just for our clients but for every member of our crew. Your voice matters, your growth matters, and you matter. Join us for a journey where your uniqueness is not only recognized but celebrated, and together, let’s create something extraordinary!

Your Career

We are seeking a ServiceNow Project Manager to lead and guide the work of technical staff on ServiceNow project implementations. In this client facing role, the Project Manager will manage large, complex professional services projects. The Senior PM will be responsible for leading, coaching and mentoring a team to drive project implementations. If you’re ready to take your career to the next level and want to feel empowered to ensure projects success, then this is the job for you! We know how valuable your problem-solving and leadership skills are to our company’s success, so if you are ready to steer high-level projects to success, we are excited to have you on our team!

Your Impact

  • - Act as an intermediary between business and technical teams.
    • Define project scope, objectives, and communication plans.
    • Plan project stages, assess business implications, and monitor progress.
    • Assign resources, timelines, and schedules.
    • Lead crew and customer meetings.
    • Oversee project execution, budget, forecasts, schedule, and scope.
    • Identify and mitigate risks and dependencies.
    • Utilize Agile and iterative project methodologies.

    • Provide coaching, mentoring, and cross-training opportunities for team members.
    • Identify and manage risks and issues, including escalations.
    • Deliver Managed Services Offering as per subscription, adhering to SOW provisions.

Your Experience

  • 8+ years of business-related experience, with a minimum of 7 years in technology Project/Program management, with highly desired Agile Project Management principles and experience.
  • Experience in strategic planning, resource allocation, monitoring of project process, and detailing schedule reports on measurable items such as milestones and deliverables.

  • Demonstrated experience managing projects throughout the entire execution to ensure success as defined by adherence to standards of scope, budget, and timeline.

  • Strong written and verbal communication skills
  • Strong facilitation skills

  • Ability to assess and mitigate risk
  • Experience leading and motivating a team
  • Comfortable working in a matrixed organization

Education

Certifications & Knowledge

The candidate must be willing and able to continue their education within the ServiceNow platform and beyond. It is expected that the candidate will be able to complete ServiceNow competency Certifications as well as Module Accreditations.

Certifications:
